description: This file defines the enum DataType representing the types of elements in a TensorFlow Tensor, including their properties and associated methods.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: Enum representing the types of elements that tensors can contain in TensorFlow Java API, with associated properties such as numeric code and byte size.

methods.name: byteSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the data type, or -1 if variable.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Returns the corresponding integer value of the DataType for use in the TensorFlow C API.

methods.name: fromC
methods.description: Constructs a DataType from its C API integer value.

methods.name: fromClass
methods.description: Returns the DataType enum corresponding to the Java class provided.
